title: Apply to establish each apprenticeship or traineeship
what: Apply to the Commissioner, within 28 days of employing an apprentice or trainee, to establish the apprenticeship or traineeship.

sources.title: Apprenticeship and Traineeship Act 2001 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Within 28 days after the date on which an employer employs a person as an apprentice or trainee, the employer must, if he or she has not already done so, apply to the Commissioner for the establishment of the relevant apprenticeship or traineeship

reach.condition: if it employs an apprentice or trainee
